displayName: Maisons du Monde API - Promo Prices, Product Data, Reviews, Store Stock
description: Maisons du Monde API for promo prices and product data on maisonsdumonde.com - search and category grids (40 per page, exact total, sorted by price or customer rating, filtered by price, discount, stock, rating, color, material, style, brand or marketplace seller) with price, the crossed-out price, discount, badges, rating and who sells it (Maisons du Monde or a marketplace seller); one product in full with exact online stock, variants, dimensions, materials, documents, review summary, Q&A and the same product on every other market; Black Friday, Seconde Chance and any category's discounted items; reviews pooled across markets with a star histogram and cursor paging; stores near a postcode, one store's phone, hours and services, and one item's stock at one store with the delivery from-price; marketplace sellers and their catalogs. 9 markets in 6 languages (fr, be, lu, nl, de, es, it, pt in EUR; ch in CHF). 9 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
